title: Fixture binder for the watch-fidelity comparison rig
summary: A hand-written, always-pending binder committed so the watch fidelity checks have a served page whose wave shape never depends on whichever binder happens to be live in this repo when the check runs.
motivation: The visual checks in the watch-fidelity binder need a served page that renders the same thing every time. This binder's slug is deliberately fictitious: no karta/watch-fidelity-fixture-demo/* ref exists anywhere in this repo, so every item below always derives as pending and the page always shows one binder, one wave, one card.

included: nothing real — this binder is a fixture, not a plan

work_items.title: Fixture work item
work_items.summary: A single item with no dependencies, so the page renders exactly one pending wave holding exactly one card, every time this fixture is served.

assertions: the fixture exists so a served page has something to render
